p: wealth: Or power, both in virtue, authority and riches.
glean ears of corn after him: Her humility declares her great love for her mother in law, for she spared no hardship to get both their livings.
Let thine eyes be on the: That is, take notice of what field they reap.
stranger: Of the Moabites, who are enemies of God's people.
wings thou art come to trust: Signifying, that she would never lack anything, if she put her trust in God, and lived under his protection.
left: Which she brought home to her mother in law.
That is, from her bag, as it is in the Chaldee text.
dead: To my husband and children, when they were alive, and now to us.
